shared_elements: horizontal register or banded organisation of the surface (band of repeated small marks in A; horizontal lines of repeated signs in B)
justification: A depicts a narrative procession of human figures in profile leading horned rams past a stylised tree, with a rosette border beneath; B shows only a badly eroded rock face with faint horizontal lines of repeated small signs and no identifiable figural imagery. The only shared feature is the generic organisation of content into horizontal bands of repeated small units, which is far too common to indicate a shared iconographic scheme.
